items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I talked with Glazer and worked out the booking through him.

ctx.x: And I said, yeah, I'll do that, but if I do that, and he says, okay, do you still want to go? He said, oh yeah. So that's what I did. I talked with Glazer and worked out the booking through him. The next time that I saw him in New Orleans was over that fiasco with Punch Miller, which I wrote about in I Remember Jazz.
